details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:578-581 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The Claude judge path inherits workflow credentials while processing untrusted input with write-capable Bash access.
  WHY: Prompt injection can expose or use inherited credentials; all reviewers rated this BLOCKER.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:576-577 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Project activation deduplication accepts marker comments without verifying the author.
  WHY: Any commenter can forge a marker and cause activation verification and gap reporting to be skipped.
- scripts/activation_verify.sh:121-125 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: PR-mode activation deduplication accepts an activation-fix marker in the linked issue body without verifying its author.
  WHY: A forged marker can suppress activation verification for the merged PR and prevent gap reporting.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:84-87 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `_trusted()` accepts any `[bot]` login or OWNER, MEMBER, or COLLABORATOR association instead of requiring the pipeline's own GH_PAT login.
  WHY: A third-party bot or collaborator can create a forged tracker that `find_issue()` selects and the pipeline then updates with operator steps. Severity disagreement: one reviewer rated this NIT; the others rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/unblock_ledger.py:409-425 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The destructive override validates approved paths but does not carry them to the implementation guard.
  WHY: The bulk-delete marker can permit unrelated non-canonical deletions outside the model-approved path set.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:1879 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The spent-override ID extraction applies `.[0]` to a single captured string from `scan(...)`.
  WHY: It extracts only the first character of each comment ID, so spent markers are not recognized and the override can be reused.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:506 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Run-ID extraction applies `.[0]` to a single captured string from `scan(...)`.
  WHY: The truncated ID can make `gh run view` receive an invalid or unrelated run ID, so the judge lacks the intended failing-run log evidence.
- scripts/unblock_actions.py:300-306 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The close plan adds `ai:unblock-closed` before attempting to close the issue or PR.
  WHY: If the close request fails, the still-open item has a label that causes future scans to skip it permanently.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:20 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The issue-opened clarify predicate does not exclude `ai:operator-step`.
  WHY: Creating an operator-step tracker can start the normal clarify, plan, and implement pipeline on that tracker.
- .github/workflows/internal-clarify.yml:18 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The issue-opened internal-clarify predicate does not exclude `ai:operator-step`.
  WHY: Creating an operator-step tracker can start the normal AI issue pipeline on that tracker.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:72-80, 338, 431-440, 485-488 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Comment-fetch failures are treated as empty history, and failure to post a project-level ledger marker does not stop the planned action.
  WHY: The ledger can miss prior verdicts and rounds, bypassing never-repeat and round limits or leaving project-wide accounting incomplete.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:169-174 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The writer creates an issue with the `ai:operator-step` label without ensuring that the label exists.
  WHY: Core-profile consumers may lack the label, causing issue creation to fail and operator steps to be silently lost.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:151-174 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The operator-step tracker upsert is an unsynchronized read-modify-write.
  WHY: Concurrent runs can overwrite each other's entries or create duplicate tracker issues.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:509 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The run log tail is limited by line count but not by bytes.
  WHY: A long log line or dense tail can exceed codex-cli's stdin limit and prevent the judge from producing output.
- agents.md:1201-1208, 1408-1415, 1762-1764 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `STANDALONE_AUTO_DECIDE` is duplicated in the stable log-prefix list, the `LOG_PREFIX.name` list, and the prose documentation.
  WHY: The duplicate contract entries and differing prose descriptions create conflicting documentation. Severity disagreement: one reviewer rated this BLOCKER; the others rated it MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:487-501 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The required CI aggregate reports failure with five failing tests, but the supplied log tail does not identify the failing test node IDs.
  WHY: The red required check blocks merge, and the available output does not establish whether the failures are from this PR or the base branch.
- changelog.d/6118-phase-7-unblock-judge.md | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: Two changelog fragment files are introduced under the same PR number.
  WHY: This violates CLAUDE.md §20.B's requirement for exactly one fragment per PR.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:339, 438-451, 621 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The hook is out of sync with its template counterpart and lacks support for `+=` assignment prefixes and `--repo` push argument parsing.
  WHY: The mismatch causes five `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py` failures and blocks the required CI check.
- scripts/unblock_scan.py:115 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `_latest_marker` reads a top-level `login` field, but REST comments put the login under `user.login`.
  WHY: REST-fetched comments are not recognized as authored by the expected user, so prior markers are not parsed and ledger limits can be bypassed.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:6118-6125 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The hand-over case does not match the `auto_merge_disabled` skip reason.
  WHY: The PR remains labeled `ai:review-blocked`, which the unblock scan does not pick up, so the hand-over is not performed.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18500, 23298, 23309 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The per-project loop uses a stale local `PROJECT_STATUS` after `unblock_handover_judge_output` changes the state file to `failed`.
  WHY: The project is not added to `UNBLOCK_FAILED_PROJECTS_FILE` until the next poll tick, delaying the unblock scan.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:20609-20612, 15833-15840 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The merge-deferral hand-over is attempted only when the count equals `MAX_MERGE_DEFERRALS`.
  WHY: If adding `ai:needs-human` fails at that point, later ticks do not retry it, leaving the PR outside the unblock scan's label set.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Review-blocked judge: its terminal skips (llm_failed, json_parse_failed, missing_followup_details, merged_pr_unsafe_action) add ai:needs-human to the PR." (PR description, "Hand-overs (Q13)" section)
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` hand-over case
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh` emits `judge_skip_reason=auto_merge_disabled`, `judge_skip_reason=sync_merge_failed`, and `judge_skip_reason=merge_conflict`, but `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` matches only `llm_failed*|json_parse_failed*|missing_followup_details|merged_pr_unsafe_action`; the PR remains labeled `ai:review-blocked`, which is excluded from the unblock scan's block-label set.
- requirement: CI must pass (baseline mergeability and required-check signal)
  expected_change_site: `.github/workflows/ci.yml` final aggregate `lint` job
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The supplied `pr_check_runs_context.txt` reports `failed_count: 2` and `incomplete_count: 1`; `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` finished with `5 failed, 171 passed`, but the provided `log_tail` does not include the failing test node IDs.
- requirement: "Consecutive project-judge runs with no usable output fail the project with ai:blocked."
  expected_change_site: `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` — the per-project loop's `PROJECT_STATUS` check after `unblock_handover_judge_output`
  confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: `unblock_handover_judge_output` sets `status = "failed"` in the state file, but the per-project loop reads `PROJECT_STATUS` before the judge runs, so its stale value delays adding the project to `UNBLOCK_FAILED_PROJECTS_FILE` until the next tick.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:576-579 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: Activation verification deduplication checks project marker comments without verifying the author.
  WHY: A forged marker can cause the poller to skip activation verification for the project and prevent gap detection and operator-step recording.
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:578-581 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The Claude judge path does not strip GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, and TG_BOT_SECRET from its environment.
  WHY: Untrusted issue comments, run logs, and PR diffs can prompt the write-capable Claude process to read or exfiltrate credentials.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:84-87 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: `_trusted()` accepts any `[bot]` login or OWNER, MEMBER, or COLLABORATOR association without checking the pipeline's GH_PAT login.
  WHY: An attacker can create a forged operator-step issue that `find_issue()` selects and `upsert()` updates.
- scripts/activation_verify.sh:121-125 | severity=hig
